notes.title: Swamp biome
notes.content: [p]The Swamp Biome may seem more inhospitable, but it is still rich in resources. Blue and red berries can be dropped from the trees along with wood, guaranteeing plenty of food. There are also cacti: collecting them with your hands causes injuries, but with a sickle, you can gather them without taking damage.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/becaac2fd994488a2658425554eb90e5c1b19594.png"][/img][/p][p]The swamp is not only about food. Here we also find boars that run after you — and remember: they are never alone. Saw a den? Be careful! They always appear in pairs to hunt you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/762579cf532642d8196358f707bb3e9a30802c55.png"][/img][/p][p]Want to explore the swamp safely? Then upgrade your helmet and avoid suffering from the environmental poison. Arriving unprepared here can cost you dearly![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/d70bccbfe3b60a94f24ddce12d4aaa07ec67d26b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Forest biome
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/8edda394acfe332a70fe48106d23c12b7fa7a0a9.png"][/img][/p][p]Wood, water and food in abundance, as well as many resources scattered on the ground — this is the Water Biome.[/p][p][/p][p]The food here is easy to collect safely, available in large quantity and, once roasted, it becomes delicious![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/b70341affb665e54be77a6f637bd4e6d7fab256f.png"][/img][/p][p]But the Water Biome is not only about abundance: it is also home to a very troublesome enemy. Small, protected by a bubble, but with its toxic drops it is able to bring you down. Saw a puddle of water on the ground? Then get ready to run, because the slime will be nearby.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/670f28d58ec747dd410d6b356e9c418f1df2d5bb.png"][/img][/p][p]And attention: the humidity of this biome can quickly deplete your oxygen. To avoid problems, upgrade your helmet at the base’s tool table and explore safely.[/p]

notes.title: Forest biome
notes.content: [p]This is where your exploration begins, your ship always crashes right in this biome! The food here is weak, but it keeps you alive during the first days of exploration. Little fruits that regenerate and mushrooms to help you get by on this journey.[/p][p][/p][p]And if you craft an axe, you can already find wood right here![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/b06a1c058c9427d2f6820bfb1454617f6f4cddaa.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You don’t need to do anything to improve your helmet, you’re already ready to explore. But be careful with those spiny creatures! They run away from you, but not before trying to scare you with their shower of spikes. Nothing is ever that simple, right?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/e3e23c86618263fbf5d9e2214bb3d1895ae65ba8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And it doesn’t stop there — in this biome you’ll also find story chests, compasses that show you where oxygen deposits are scattered around, and the heart piece, right? But that’s a subject for another time.[/p]

notes.title: OXIGEN
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/aa1d526eb79ac59129b20d807979b4dc066b867d.gif"][/img]At the base, there is an exclusive room to take care of oxygen. In this oxygen machine, you can upgrade the oxygen tank in your helmet, allowing you to extend your exploration time with each upgrade.

Remember: upgrades are made using oxygen stones (blue ones).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/866e7ea48ef1b374750394ad8b6b6fd068556cd6.gif"][/img]During your exploration journey, you might be lucky enough to come across one of these oxygen stocks, where you can restore 100 oxygen in the middle of your journey. Additionally, they regenerate every day—have you thought about planning a route that always passes by them? You just need to be lucky enough to find them quickly!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/32056a22dc3493b52efc73407c5074c458559375.png"][/img]Remember the upgrade we mentioned earlier? These are the stones needed for those upgrades. To collect them, you'll need a pickaxe! Spoiler: there’s a biome full of these opportunities. Just go there and collect them!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/d68bc525314bcf12fd391ebc1ec96af4f07a126e.gif"][/img]Well, if none of that works, you can always rely on the blue mushrooms. They are scattered around the planet, and consuming them will restore a bit of oxygen. If you gather them, take them back to the base, and cook them, the effect is even greater! Oh, and cooked blue mushrooms have infinite durability, so you can stock up without worry.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/783190d9f15f2de842e3c8a25a0bb73c1d7e7cd9.png"][/img][/p][p]In the swamp biome, you’ll find a tree that produces two types of fruit. One of them is the [b]oxygen fruit[/b],  and if you combine it with a [b]common fruit[/b] and a pinch of [b]Perlimpimpim powder[/b], you can prepare a special [b]Smoothie[/b] that restores your oxygen and never spoils! A true survival smoothie, you just need to find the right ingredients (and the swamp, of course…).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/2ceb72372e386a77e380670a5de3b21d394b794f.png"][/img][/p][p]If you upgrade the base’s stove, you'll unlock the ability to cook the [b]oxygen fruit[/b] in an advanced way. The result? A delicious and powerful [b]oxygen jelly[/b], perfect to always carry with you on long expeditions.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/cf64b6a069d9c25ab13a40d34b0ab775baa39f2d.png"][/img][/p][p]During your journey through the desert, keep an eye out: there's a hidden [b]soda machine[/b] out there. If you insert a [b]coin[/b], there’s a chance you’ll get an [b]oxygen Smoothie[/b]! But beware: this one isn’t everlasting. If you leave it unused for too long, it can spoil, so choose wisely when to drink it.[/p]

notes.title: KITCHEN
notes.content:
In this exploration adventure, we're already running low on oxygen, so let's not run out of food, right? And what’s the best way to stave off hunger? With cooked food! During your exploration, gather as many ingredients as possible. Remember, the stove needs fuel to operate, so be sure to collect twigs and grasses as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/f5183d47ba48dc1fc79523a3805a44100b925cc9.gif[/img]

Like everything else on the ship, the base stove has multiple levels. You start with it broken, and once you manage to fix it, you'll have access to cooking the foods from the biome where the ship crashed... those mushrooms and berries you found early on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/dd8f50fbaddcbe2b0c6eeecbaa7993956fdf3d98.gif[/img]

As you upgrade the stove, new recipes will appear, including ones using meat you get from hunting with traps, as well as the berries that fall from trees.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/9781f4100c95649cd2f1f461fd35373e0d925bc4.gif[/img]

Explore the use of various ingredients from different biomes.

Ever tried grabbing a cactus? But be careful when collecting it because of the thorns; using a machete makes the harvest safer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/956663cc29e80127f08d4259590e405fda8f935c.gif[/img]

At the second-to-last level of the kitchen, you’ll learn to make even more elaborate dishes, combining dishes and ingredients from previous levels. And guess what? Now the meals restore health, hunger, and oxygen. 3-in-1 is always better, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/f0ef336d9fc60b108e13d98ac6734596d77556fd.gif[/img]

The last level of the stove brings the ultimate excitement: the most elaborate dishes get a version that doesn’t spoil! Use the "kindness powder" on food, and it will no longer have an expiration date, allowing you to stockpile a massive amount and (who knows?!) never worry about food again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/c17129af35f288bf679057060ab9a9e166a7e326.gif[/img]

On top of all that, you can also repair your fridge! With this improvement, each ingredient you store stays protected and fresh twice as long as it would in your inventory or chest. This means less waste and more time to focus on exploration and upgrading your ship!

notes.title: BIOMES
notes.content:
[b]Exploration!!! Exploration! Exploration![/b]

In the exploration part of Kind Heart Survivors gameplay, there are 5 different biomes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/f975c2368f57f83663c204b64180cbb8db822396.gif[/img]
[b]Biome Arid[/b]

A biome where we don't find trees, but we find several other very important things. It's possible to kill hunger by eating some termites, and if you're willing to take the risk, you can also kill hunger by eating some cacti. The rest appears so rarely that it's hard to count much, but sometimes finding that simple item saves the day too, right?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/6b3da4a075b5c1bba88b951a8e33c6a371f6a4c8.gif[/img]
[b]Biome Forest[/b]

Now it's time for trees and little fruits, after all, nothing like some wood to fix a ship. Jokes aside, we also put a lot of mushrooms and fruits in this biome, after all, the ship crashes into it. We don't need to let our players die of hunger so quickly, right?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/4159d37d0e0fd8c58e3ec26fd67fd31dbc6fc394.gif[/img]
[b]Biome Rocky[/b]

Time to get as many rocks as you can! And in this biome, besides big rocks, there's a special item, the oxygen stone. This stone is used to upgrade the oxygen machine at the base. You know what that means? More exploration time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/cad598021e491f82f7105908dd4b4638e0bb5166.gif[/img]
[b]Biome Swampy[/b]

Just because it's damp doesn't mean it's good, right? Here the plants are thorny, but we have fruits and trees, after all, to cook we need firewood, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/36ccc2cae159985483c636259ab492cf3ba52051.gif[/img]
[b]Biome Aquatic[/b]

If the other biome was already humid, imagine this one? But in the future, fishes will be added to this biome, besides that, we have trees and roots. I think for those who want to stock food, it's a good biome to pass through.

notes.title: BASE WITH CRAFTING, WE HAVE!
notes.content:
The pilots from the Kind universe were attacked, and their shot-down ship crashed into this location, never before explored by them. But a survival game is not just about exploration. In Kind Heart Survivors, we have two gameplay modes: exploration and base building with crafting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/a2ce5822bfff6daaca81b115be1043fec22113d6.gif[/img]

During the exploration period, we have the oxygen limiter. However, in the base, we have the advantage of oxygen not running out, so it's a time to make decisions calmly, produce tools, cook, and gradually repair the ship to escape from this inhospitable planet. Have you decided it's time to explore again? Just step out through this door.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/ba8e0bfe03699564ecc9172d7ac0fc285284d8db.gif[/img]

To leave this world's end, do you know what you need? You need to gather the pieces of the kind heart! This is the base location where you must place the collected pieces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858513/646574d5d9479513dd35a29b9832155e731d87bd.gif[/img]

A good survival game couldn't come without inventory management, right? In the base, you can create and upgrade various chests to store the supplies you gather from outside.
